decisions.reason: Step 2.3 conflated fields in different tangent fibres. The main witness J(t)=t^2 partial_x at t already has residual 2 partial_x and refutes the claim, so this is nonfatal. Defined bar J(t)=t^2 partial_x at 0 for the constant curve; its residual is also nonzero. The Jacobi definition and coordinate connection, curvature and geodesic formulas justify both computations without choice.

The asserted v in E_p is false on incomplete manifolds, as the supplied (0,1) example shows. Replaced it by r(t)/|v| in [0,b-a] subset I_{p,v}, and stated the actual full time-scaling interface in F1. This repairs the equality implication without completeness or a weakened conclusion. Also supplied the metric/manifold topology and intrinsic compactness interfaces for the finite inverse-branch cover, Levi-Civita compatibility for constant speed, the interval-diameter Lebesgue argument, and piecewise C1 regularity of the direction. The lift patches by injectivity, Gauss lemma bounds smoothed radius, and equality forces zero angular derivative and monotone radius.

F8 cited a scalar chain rule for a composition of smooth manifold maps; replaced it with the existing manifold differential chain rule. The initial-data map w -> J_w is a linear bijection onto fields vanishing initially, and its restriction identifies ker d exp_v with fields vanishing at both endpoints. Equal tangent dimensions give singularity iff noninjectivity. Added explicit exponential smoothness, derivative at zero and linear-kernel suppliers; the choice-free coordinate inverse theorem and chain rule establish the local-diffeomorphism equivalence. Claims and AC_omega assumption are unchanged.

F6 only characterizes the radical on piecewise-C2 fields; applying it to an arbitrary piecewise-C1 radical field left the asserted exact nullspace unproved. On the sphere an explicit parallel orthonormal frame gives integral(x prime dot y prime - Bx dot y)=0. Set H=integral Bx and test with y=integral(h-average h), h=x prime+H, on each closed piece. Integration by parts forces integral|h-average h|^2=0, giving piecewise C2 regularity. F6 then applies, while integration by parts proves the reverse inclusion on the full C1 domain. Corrected s_u prime to -(sin(t/R)/R)p+cos(t/R)u and retained the full sphere minimality and n-1 nullity claims.

The metric definition does not assert compatibility with a connection. F4 now cites def-levi-civita-connection for compatibility, licensing constant speed and length pi R. The sphere cut-time and conjugacy interfaces give minimization and multiplicity n-1. Renamed the orthonormal pair e_1,e_2 so it no longer collides with u_m=(e_1+m e_2)/sqrt(1+m^2); coefficient comparison makes m -> u_m injective, and equal geodesic maps have equal initial velocities. No statement or choice requirement changed.

The last equality in step 4.1 wrongly erased c(v_k). Restored the estimate c(v_k)|v_k-v|+|c(v_k)-c(v)|. Step 1.1 already proves c(v_k)=d(p,q_k) converges to a finite L, hence is bounded, so the first product tends to zero and the closedness argument survives this local arithmetic correction. Added the metric/manifold topology interface to justify metric convergence of exponential images and corrected the AC audit step reference. The compact-direction subsequence and extended cut-time continuity then identify q=exp_p(c(v)v).

Step 1.6 established openness only in d_g before invoking a smooth open-submanifold interface. Added the existing theorem identifying that topology with the manifold topology, and explicitly applied it before forming the restricted smooth structure. Added Levi-Civita metric compatibility for the unit-speed use in F10. Cut-time continuity makes D_p open; the characterization excludes conjugacy and second minimizers below cut time; Hopf-Rinow supplies surjectivity, and the unique global inverse agrees locally with smooth inverses. Clarified that the reciprocal-norm difference tends to zero in step 1.1.

The zero-length-cover sentence is false: [x,x] covers {x}, and singleton intervals cover any enumerated countable set. This does not affect the main counterexample: the fat-Cantor supplier explicitly allows a_k=b_k and gives total cover length at least 1/2 for S. Replaced the sentence by that exact quantitative argument and explicitly included perfectness in F1, already supplied by the theorem. Empty interior still fails to imply nullity, without any change to the Statement or the cut-locus theorem.

The nonunit-W sentence omitted the essential W in D_p premise. On the unit circle W=3pi/2 reaches a point by the longer arc, and its radial direction opposes the distance gradient. The Statement and main proof already assume 0<t<c_p(v); repaired the supplementary sentence by taking W in D_p, v=W/|W| and t=|W|. Differentiating r_p composed with exp_p on D_p gives the norm differential, and Gauss lemma plus surjectivity of d exp identifies the unique unit gradient. Also corrected the meaningless t=1/t times t phrase to division justified by t>0 and repaired the broken notin escape.
